high_level_description: This image depicts a cozy and stylish interior scene featuring a wooden cabinet with intricate geometric carvings on its doors. The cabinet is open, revealing neatly folded blankets or throws inside. On top of the cabinet, there is a stack of books, a decorative vase with a black, wire-like design, a small golden sphere, and a tall, metallic lamp with a white shade. To the right of the cabinet, there is a large, ornate vase with detailed patterns, placed on the floor. The background includes a window that offers a view of greenery outside, suggesting a serene and natural setting.
